description: Endorphins Running helps authenticated runners review their private profile, active and historical training plans, scheduled workouts, recent activities, pace and heart-rate zones, training load, personal records, goals, coaching memories, weekly summaries, and recent plan adjustments. The currently authorized tools provide personalized training context without modifying workouts, plans, or external services.
